Deep-rooted High Plains broadleaf break crop; scavenges deep subsoil nitrate.
Southern Plains winter canola; suppresses feral rye and jointed goatgrass in winter wheat rotations.
Spring oat cover/grain crop; low water footprint ahead of winter wheat.
Cool-season legume that fits before sorghum or corn.
